brief: Two-storey brick commercial building whose blank side wall carries a huge painted tobacco advertisement, faded but legible; plain storefront below, flat roof. Record: 2 photos (streetscape with the painted wall).

facade.notes: Collinsville IL streetscape (1890s blocks): a blank brick side wall carrying a huge painted 'BULL DURHAM / BEST FOR THREE GENERATIONS' tobacco ad with the bull, a rooftop eagle sign; a vacant lot beside it used for parking; other brick fronts down the street

why.note: blank party walls at lot lines (no openings allowed) became billboards
a neighbour demolished: the party wall now faces a parking lot
